slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers review says it found no evidence of digital case management or record-keeping in rural police stations or gendarmerie brigades and no national police IT system for rural use; no date is given, so the published date is used.

The Data Landscapers review concludes that rural police stations and gendarmerie brigades are entirely paper-based, citing poor recordkeeping of arrests and detentions (US State Department, 2022) and records destroyed in the 2013 conflict; no date is given for the conclusion, so the published date is used.

systems.system: MINUSCA donation of computers, printers and solar power to Baoro police station and gendarmerie (2025), to draft procès-verbaux and investigation reports
systems.tiers: Baoro, a rural station; described as not yet implemented widely
